title: PBMC from healthy control 3
extract_protocol_ch1: Collect 2 mL of peripheral venous blood from each sample in EDTA-anticoagulant tubes and dilute with 2 mL of PBS. The blood was layered onto the 3mL Ficoll-Paque (GE Healthcare, Sweden) in a 10 ml centrifuge tube and centrifuged at 400 g, 18˚C for 30 min. The PBMC fraction was transferred to another tube and washed 2 times with PBS to obtain a single cell suspension.

The final single cell suspension is loaded onto a microfluidic device the protocol of the Singleron GEXSCOPE Single Cell RNA Library Kit (Singleron Biotechnologies) according to the protocol of the Singleron GEXSCOPE Single Cell RNA Library Kit (Singleron Biotechnologies), which involves cell lysis, mRNA capture, labeling cells (barcode) and mRNA (UMI), reverse transcription of mRNA into cDNA and amplification, and finally cDNA fragmentation. Individual libraries were diluted to 4 nM and pooled for sequencing. Pools were sequenced on an Illumina HiSeq X with 150 bp paired end reads.
